brand.title: Everest Recipe Book
hero.desc: Every dish on the Everest menu, with the exact ingredients, weights and steps from the kitchen. Search by dish or by ingredient, and print any selection as a PDF.
search.placeholder: Search by dish or ingredient (e.g. potato, paneer, chicken)
search.label: Search recipes
sort.label: Sort
sort.name: Name
empty.title: No recipes match
empty.desc: Try a shorter search or clear the filters. You can search by ingredient too — try "potato".
detail.stepHint: Tap a step to mark it done. Progress is saved on this device.
detail.notFoundDesc: The address is wrong, or this recipe has been removed.
table.name: Ingredient
print.hint: {n} recipes · {pages} A4 pages — choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog.
print.emptyDesc: Pick recipes with the ＋ button on each card in the list.
theme.label: Theme
lang.label: Language
footer.download: Download the whole app (one offline file)
prep.usedInHint: What you make here goes into these dishes. Tap to open.
login.title: Manager sign-in
login.desc: Signing in is required to edit recipes. Browsing, search and PDF export all work without it.
login.failed: That ID or password is not right.
login.unsupported: This browser cannot sign in. Please open the page in a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
login.noAccounts: No manager accounts exist yet. Create one in the repository first with `npm run user add <id> <name>`.
login.note: This lock exists to prevent accidental edits. The app has no server, so it is not a security measure.
edit.title: Edit recipe
edit.hint: Edits are saved on this device and show up immediately. To send them to someone, press “💾 Save edited app” in the bar below — it builds an app file with your changes in it.
edit.name: Dish name
edit.flag: This recipe differs from the original
edit.locked: Photo, category, tags and menu order cannot be changed here — they come from the source workbook and the ordering rules.
editbar.local: saved on this device — “Save edited app” builds an app file with your changes in it
editbar.saved: {file} saved — send this file on and you are done
add.title: Add a dish
add.desc: Fill this in in Korean. Only the English name and category are asked for here — the rest of the English text can be filled in afterwards by switching to EN.
add.name: Dish name
add.photoHint: Scaled down to 900px on the long edge. Without one, the section icon is shown instead.
add.enHint: English ingredients and steps start out identical to the Korean. After creating the dish, switch to EN and fill them in under “Edit recipe”.
add.required: Section, category, both dish names, one ingredient and one step are required.
del.confirmDesc: “{name}” will be taken out of the list.
del.warnExisting: The original stays untouched. You can undo this any time from the bar below, and it only reaches a file once you press “Save edited app”.
del.warnNew: You created this dish on this device, so deleting it cannot be undone.
del.blocked: {n} other dishes use this as an ingredient, so it cannot be deleted.
